projects.unit_title: Mathematical Habits and Place Value to One Million
projects.title: Build a Ten Times Bigger explainer showing place-value relationships with models, comparisons, and a rounding decision made for a stated purpose.
success_criteria: The mathematics is accurate and every result is shown with a model, calculation, or process.
Each decision is justified against the situation, not asserted.
At least one error check appears in the work and is explained.
The product is revised at least once in response to feedback against these criteria.
projects.adult_role: Give feedback against the criteria and supply access supports. The adult or tutor does not complete any part of the graded product.
accessible_alternatives: spoken explanation with an adult scribe
physical model built from household objects
projects.no_media_path: The product may be entirely text, numbers, and hand-drawn diagrams. No photograph, recording, video, or published post is required, and none is required to be shared outside the household.
projects.safety_and_privacy: Use de-identified data. Do not collect names, addresses, images, or personal details of other people. Measuring tasks involving tools, heat, or liquids require adult supervision and may be replaced with a paper alternative.
